criteria.text: After sendInput(sessionId, text) is called, controller.transcriptFor(sessionId) must contain an AgentSessionMessage with role == 'input' and strippedText == text. User messages must appear in the mini-bubble's transcript pipeline, which reads transcriptFor.
criteria.test_id: issue-635-c1: sendInput adds optimistic user message to transcriptFor

criteria.text: The expanded mini-bubble renders a user message widget for the role='input' entry produced by sendInput. The _MiniMessageBlock for isInput=true must be rendered in the bubble's Column, not filtered out.
criteria.test_id: issue-635-c2: mini-bubble renders user message after sendInput
